# Ground

> **Kind:** component · **Registry:** world · **Folder:** [`src/logic/components/`](../folders/src-logic-components.md)
> **Source:** [`src/logic/components/rigid_body.h`](../../../src/logic/components/rigid_body.h)

## Summary

A flat static Jolt box whose top face is at top_y, centred on the origin in XZ.

## Description

Flat ground of the test worlds (physics.md): RigidBodySys creates a static box of `size` full extents on the STATIC layer at (0, top_y - size.y/2, 0) in init (so world systems can place bodies on it in their init) and again in every tick for new ones; the on_destroy hook removes it. Scene JSON only (scene entities exist in worlds), usually through the `ground_flat` prefab; WorldView draws it.

## Scene JSON

"Ground": { "size": [x, y, z], "top_y", "friction", "restitution" } (sizes must be positive)

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `size` | `glm::vec3` | (150, 10, 150) | full extents, world units |
| `top_y` | `float` | 0 | height of the top face |
| `friction` | `float` | 1 | Jolt friction |
| `restitution` | `float` | 0 | Jolt restitution |
| `body` | `uint32_t` | 0xffffffff | JPH::BodyID, assigned by RigidBodySys |
